name: Situ Xiuping
source:
As Lillian's right-hand man, he runs a very lucrative luxury company. Although he serves as the Executive Director, he is not keen on making any decisions or comments. Yet he enjoys his unquestionable authority respected not only by his subordinates but also Lillian, the Chairman of the Board.

He often have secretive talks with Lillian and yet it looks like they are only talking about private matters.
translation:
As Lillian's right-hand man, he runs a very lucrative luxury company. Although he serves as the Executive Director, he is not keen on making any decisions or comments. Yet he enjoys his unquestionable authority respected not only by his subordinates but also Lillian, the Chairman of the Board.

He often have secretive talks with Lillian and yet it looks like they are only talking about private matters.
